limitations: One CPU, one timed input; no cross-CPU or whole-audio-chain speed claim.
Original-power guards are separate paced comparisons; do not transfer continuous-policy percentages.
Native AVX-VNNI unavailable; its objects are byte-identical and fallback refusal tested, native speed is unmeasured.
Ordinary work excluded from CPU2+6; bound kernel work, IRQ/NMI/SMI, shared LLC/package power remain.
Exact spectra/state relative to current W7A8 baseline; no new perceptual scores.
No claim that every possible layout/prefetch schedule or global optimum has been exhausted.
